sources.title: A3 Compressor: Activation‑Aware Factorized SVD Compression with Fisher ...
sources.snippet: Traditional low‑rank factorization (SVD) works well on dense layers but often fails when applied to attention projections because it ignores the activation statistics of the input. The A3 Compressor (Activation‑Aware Factorized SVD Compression with Fisher Weighting and LayerNorm Recalibration) overcomes this limitation.
